body.name: Worked exact certificate for the rational witness
body.construction: Let \(t=w_1\), \(W(t)=16t/(1+15t)=w_0\), and let \(F_a(t,z;\vartheta)=(1-w_a(t))(\vartheta-1)z^2+[1+(w_a(t)-r_a)(\vartheta-1)]z-r_a\), where \(w_1(t)=t\), \(w_0(t)=W(t)\), \(r_1=53/100\), and \(r_0=6/25\).  On this reverse arc, \(\pi-w_1>0\) and \(\pi-w_0<0\).  The lower branch is therefore \(H^-=q_1(1/36)-q_0(1/36)\), and its endpoint is the unique legal solution of \(F_1(t,z_1;1/36)=F_0(t,z_0;1/36)=0\) and \(d\{q_1(t;1/36)-q_0(t;1/36)\}/dt=0\) in \(t\in[251392284/10^9,251392285/10^9]\), \(z_1\in[688551450/10^9,688551451/10^9]\), and \(z_0\in[841040182/10^9,841040183/10^9]\); its pair obeys \(w_0\in[843088267/10^9,843088268/10^9]\) and \(L\in[-107500302/10^9,-107500301/10^9]\).  The upper branch is \(H^+=q_1(36)-q_0(36)\), and its endpoint is the unique legal solution of the analogous system at \(\vartheta=36\) in \(t\in[242967344/10^9,242967345/10^9]\), \(z_1\in[392390615/10^9,392390616/10^9]\), and \(z_0\in[10930193/10^9,10930194/10^9]\); its pair obeys \(w_0\in[837004844/10^9,837004845/10^9]\) and \(R\in[539509967/10^9,539509968/10^9]\).  Both are reverse-arc stationary candidates satisfying exactly \(w_0(1-w_1)=16w_1(1-w_0)\), while the inactive exposure inequality has slack \(16w_0(1-w_1)-w_1(1-w_0)=255w_1(1-w_0)>0\).  In every displayed box, \(0<z_a<1\), \(m_{a,1}=\vartheta z_a/\{1+(\vartheta-1)z_a\}\in(0,1)\), and \(r_a=(1-w_a)z_a+w_am_{a,1}\) hold with positive denominators.  Complementing \(U\) gives the second attaining pair and replaces \(\vartheta\) by \(1/\vartheta\).  For the separate-pair lower endpoint, the treated-minimum reverse-arc branch uses \((w_0,w_1)=(6064/6935,379/1250)\), \(\vartheta=1/36\), and \(q_1=94711/277400\), while the control-maximum reverse-arc branch uses \((516/625,129/565)\), \(\vartheta=1/36\), and \(q_0=2553/5650\); hence \(L_{\mathrm{sep}}=-3461701/31346200\in[-110434471/10^9,-110434470/10^9]\).  For the separate-pair upper endpoint, the treated-maximum reverse-arc branch uses \((6736/7565,421/1250)\), \(\vartheta=36\), and \(q_1=212689/302600\), while the control-minimum reverse-arc branch uses \((334/625,167/2495)\), \(\vartheta=36\), and \(q_0=1797/12475\); hence \(R_{\mathrm{sep}}=84380923/150997400\in[558823681/10^9,558823682/10^9]\).  These four separate candidates lie on the same reverse arc and satisfy the same exact active identity and strict inactive inequality.  After eliminating \(z_1,z_0\) and saturating by \(t(1-t)\) and all mixture denominators, let \(g_-\) and \(g_+\) be the primitive square-free degree-sixteen stationary factors for \(\vartheta=1/36\) and \(\vartheta=36\).  Their leading and constant coefficients are respectively \((4404233927002616960449218750000000000,11933213589796668025115770443)\) and \((6602797178337116825836523437500000000000,16287023439341598675579810131)\).  The Sturm-sign strings at the lower box endpoints are \(+--+++-----+-+-++\) and \(---+++-----+-+-++\), giving variation counts \(8\) and \(7\); at the upper box endpoints they are \(-++--+++++--++--+\) and \(+++--+++++--++--+\), giving counts \(7\) and \(6\).  Thus each box isolates one stationary root.  Exact interval subtraction yields \(L-L_{\mathrm{sep}}\in[2934168/10^9,2934170/10^9]\) and \(R_{\mathrm{sep}}-R\in[19313713/10^9,19313715/10^9]\).  \(\mathcal C^\star\) consists of these rational boxes, identities, Sturm data, analytic-branch signs, and interval evaluations showing that every other legal arc, endpoint, corner, and stationary box has a strictly inferior objective value.
